response.content: {"critique": "The problem claims high-value clients are confused by unexplained renewal price increases and cannot see how pricing is calculated. I checked all five similar items: 'Document classifier confidence threshold' (4133, unstarted), 'Policyholder milestone notifications' (Notion roadmap page), 'Payment history improvements' (4130, completed 2026-09-15), 'Task list improvements' (4134, in progress), and 'Activity timeline display' (4132, completed 2026-09-15). None address renewal pricing transparency or pricing calculation visibility; the closest, 'Payment history improvements,' only covers transaction tracking and reconciliation, not explaining price increases. No shipped story or roadmap item covers this problem, so it remains open.", "verdict": "pass"}
